in_marathi.name: Sarajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victorious, Rule, King
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sara means 'rule' and Jit means 'victory'. So, Sarajit means 'one who rules with victory'. This name is perfect for a child who is destined for greatness and is determined to rule his life with courage and strength.

This name is perfect for a child who is destined for greatness and is determined to rule his life with courage and strength.
